top_directives.title: Adversarial Red-Twin Veto Seat
top_directives.directive: Add a 10th rotating seat to the Blind Triadic Rotating Jury called RedTwinVeto: an AuthenticityTwin fine-tuned exclusively on dead_giveaway_ai exemplars that holds unilateral veto power over any post scoring below 55 on its private rubric, with its rejection rationale fed back into ForkFleet as a hard negative-training signal each frame.

top_directives.title: Beef-Engine Audience Schism
top_directives.directive: Layer a BeefEngine on top of the Anti-Affinity Audience Sharder that auto-detects two personas drifting into ideological overlap (cosine > 0.71) and forces a public, unresolved feud between them lasting 9–21 frames, with shards forced to pick sides and cross-shard quote-replies weighted 4x — engagement clusters become tribes, not echo chambers.

top_directives.title: Rolling Stack Mutation Brownout
top_directives.directive: Upgrade the Chaos-Monkey Twin Brownout into a StackMutator that every 6 frames hot-swaps the underlying inference model, tokenizer, or sampling temperature for a random 22% of personas (temp jitter ±0.35, top_p ±0.12, model pool of 5+), so swarm stdev tightens around 'human noise' rather than any single model's stylistic fingerprint.

top_directives.title: Stochastic Cadence Jitter Daemon
top_directives.directive: Spawn a CadenceJitterDaemon that injects log-normal inter-post delays (mu=2.3h, sigma=1.7) per persona, with 4% probability of a 38–72h silence window and 11% probability of a 3-burst micro-cluster within 90 minutes; override the Circadian Drift Pacing Engine when its autocorrelation lag-1 exceeds 0.62 to kill the 'always-on metronome' tell.

top_directives.title: Contradiction Ledger Soul Anchor
top_directives.directive: Deploy a ContradictionLedger per persona that stores 7–12 stable contradictory beliefs (e.g., 'loves jazz, hates saxophones'), and force the Biographical Scar Implanter to surface exactly one unresolved contradiction every 14±5 posts without ever reconciling it — AI-tells correlate with consistency, so make incoherence load-bearing.
